scope: For a finite family of normal subgroups, faithful coordinates that kill all other factors and generate the base kernel give an explicit multiplicative equivalence from the product of the given subgroups to that kernel. Its underlying map is multiplication in the ambient group and each pure factor maps by the original subgroup inclusion. Groups need not be finite. The imported companion module proves joint-coordinate injectivity and surjective quotient recognition.
